shared_elements: quadruped animal shown in strict profile
animals arranged in a horizontal row/register
horned or long-headed animal head in profile
weathered/eroded stone surface photographed in situ
justification: Both are stone reliefs whose principal motif is a row of quadrupeds rendered in strict profile along a horizontal band, which is the clearest correspondence. Beyond that they diverge sharply: A is a schematic, flat-cut, low-relief pillar with stacked registers of stylised animals and no human figures, while B is a modelled, highly finished frieze with patterned fleece, drapery and bearded human attendants leading the animals in a single procession.
